entries.title: I Timothy 4:1
segments: But the Spirit expressly says that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and teachings of demons,

entries.title: I Timothy 4:2
segments: speaking lies in hypocrisy, being seared in [their] own conscience,

entries.title: I Timothy 4:3
segments: forbidding to marry, [saying] to abstain from foods which God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:4
segments: For every creation of God [is] good, and nothing to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:5
segments: For it is sanctified through the Word of God and prayer.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:6
segments: Having suggested these things to the brothers, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and by the good doctrine which you have followed.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:7
segments: But refuse profane and old-womanish tales, and exercise yourself to godliness.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:8
segments: For bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the present life, and of that which is to come.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:9
segments: Faithful [is] the Word, and worthy of all acceptance.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:10
segments: For to this we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the preserver of all men, especially of those who believe.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:12
segments: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example of the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:13
segments: Until I come, attend to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:14
segments: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the body of elders.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:15
segments: Meditate on these things; be in these things in order that your improvement may appear to all.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:16
segments: Hold on to yourself and to the doctrine; continue in them, for doing this you shall both save yourself and those who hear you.
